if.test: ctx.scope != null and ctx.scope.name() != "COMPANY" and ctx.userIdList != null and ctx.userIdList.size() > 0

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.actual_duration), 2), 0) FROM field_work_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.actual_duration IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.planned_start_time, t.actual_start_time)), 2), 0) FROM field_work_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.planned_start_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(t.task_type, 'OTHER') AS taskType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.actual_duration), 2), 0) AS avgDuration FROM field_work_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.task_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT t.assignee_id AS assigneeId, COALESCE(MAX(su.real_name), MAX(t.assignee_name)) AS assigneeName, COUNT(*) AS totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedTasks, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS completionRate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.actual_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalDurationMin, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.planned_start_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.planned_start_time, t.actual_start_time) END), 2), 0) AS avgArrivalDelayMin FROM field_work_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = t.assignee_id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.assignee_id ORDER BY totalTasks DESC LIMIT 30
